results.title: Defective Blender Lawsuit [2026] | TorHoerman Law
results.content:
Her complaint alleges the blender cup is defectively designed and prone to breaking open during use, exposing users to both hot contents and the still-spinning blades inside.

She claims SharkNinja knew about the risk from prior complaints and reports but continued selling the product without adequately warning consumers or fixing the design.

The suit brings claims including strict liability, negligence, and breach of implied warranty, seeking compensation for her injuries, medical expenses, and emotional distress. [...] ## Defective Blender Lawsuit Overview

Defective blender lawsuits involve allegations that certain blenders malfunctioned during ordinary use, exposing consumers to sharp blades, broken containers, hot liquids, electrical hazards, or other preventable dangers.

These claims may examine whether a blender’s blade assembly, pitcher, lid, locking mechanism, motor, or other safety features failed because of a design defect, manufacturing defect, or inadequate warnings.

Reported injuries include deep lacerations, burn injuries, eye injuries, fractures, electrical shock, and other harm requiring emergency medical treatment or surgery. [...] You may have a potential claim if:

 You were injured while using a blender during ordinary household use.
 The blades detached, became exposed, or contacted you unexpectedly.
 The blender cracked, shattered, leaked, overheated, or ejected hot contents.
 A defective blade assembly, pitcher, lid, locking mechanism, gasket, motor, or other component contributed to the incident.
 You suffered serious lacerations, burns, eye injuries, fractures, nerve damage, or another significant injury.
 You required medical treatment, stitches, surgery, hospitalization, or ongoing care.
 You preserved the blender, broken components, photographs, proof of purchase, or medical records.
 The incident occurred within the applicable statute of limitations.

results.title: This bug makes Blender completely useless for any animation! - Animation and Rigging - Blender Artists Community
results.content:
Could this in essence be an issue to do with Blenders Action Editor and it’s system of saving animation data and files ? Often data or parts of can be lost this way. I have often myself and it can be frustrating. It’s possible to have multiple animation files for the same rig in one scene in the Action Editor and jump around between them. So it’s possible to save multiple working versions of a file. Walk .001 and Walk 002 … etc.  
Sometimes this data can be lost on saving if it has no clear user. There is the option in the Action Editor to save animation even if it has no user, The Fake User saving option. It’s always a good idea to check that just in case. [...] This is the only bug I have ever encountered in a serious piece of software that is completely unacceptable and destroys all usability of the software. Blender can never be considered “professional” anmation software if a bug like this exists, and to be perfectly honest, all developent should grind to a complete halt until a game breaking bug like this is permanently eradicated. I may have to reconsider ever using Blender again if this bug continues, and that truly crushes my heart. I want Blender, but Blender CANNOT be used for animation if it cannot be depended uon to remember work done, always and coherently.

If this is not fixed, Blender literally has no future. No, this is not hyperbole. You cannot use software that throws out your work at random. There is no way around that. [...] Last I saw it was an earlier version, I think 2.4x. It seems to be (speculation here) a problem with memory management, perhaps tied to file storage. No idea for sure, though. The only work around seems to be a complete do over of the animation which is NOT an acceptable solution on a serious project. My project is luckily not so serious this time, but it prevents me from chainging that, of course…

It is about a deepseated flaw that makes Blender a liability in animation work.

So, you want everybody accept that statement although you are not competent to make such statement.

I’m not a bug hunter

If you refuse to do minimal work to investigate why you are the only guy complaining ; don’t expect people to take your remarks seriously.
